WISP Pool (Round-Robin)
\n
\n
\n
\n
Enable pool round-robin
\n
Rotate across a benchmarked pool of public WISP servers for faster loads. Servers that fail for a site are skipped for that site; faster servers are picked more often.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n \n Not benchmarked yet\n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
Concurrent Requests\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Idle threads
\n
Max simultaneous requests when page is loaded\n (default: 3). Lower = less background CPU.
\n
\n
\n \n 3\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Active threads
\n
Max simultaneous requests during page load\n (default: 6). Higher = faster loads but more CPU.
\n
\n
\n \n 6\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n \n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n \n\n
\n
WebRTC Blocking
\n
\n
\n
\n
Block WebRTC connections
\n
Prevents sites from establishing direct peer-to-peer connections that bypass the WISP tunnel and could expose your real IP address. Off by default — may break video calls and real-time apps.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
Smart Request Headers
\n
\n
\n
\n
Spoof Sec-Fetch & Referer headers
\n
Synthesize correct Sec-Fetch-Site, Sec-Fetch-Mode, Sec-Fetch-Dest, and Referer headers based on request context. Fixes CDNs and APIs that reject requests with incorrect fetch metadata.

Browser Skin
\n
\n
Disguise GUST as another\n browser. Tabs, toolbar, menus and browser-specific extras are all\n re-dressed to match the real thing.
\n
\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
\n
*A note on GUST+. By default, GUST+ is identical to regular GUST. However, GUST+ allows you to hand pick tab styles, sidebars, home screens, and more from whichever skin does it best, then paint the whole thing in custom colors. Tune it below.

\n
Fallback Behaviour
\n
\n
\n
\n
Enable fallback on load error
\n
When a page fails to load (network error, bad status, timeout), automatically retry using the fallback proxy before showing an error page.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Log retries
\n
All fallback retry attempts are always written to the request log, including which WISP server was used.
\n
\n
always on
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
Fallback WISP Server
\n
\n \n
Used only when the primary WISP server is unreachable or returns an error. Leave blank to disable.
\n
\n \n \n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
Retry Policy
\n
\n
\n
\n
Max retry attempts (main)
\n
How many times Gust retries on the primary WISP server before switching to the fallback.
\n
\n
\n \n 3\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Max retry attempts (fallback)
\n
How many times Gust will attempt the fallback WISP before giving up and showing an error.
\n
\n
\n \n 3\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Retry delay (seconds)
\n
Wait time between each retry attempt before switching to the fallback server.
\n
\n
\n \n 3\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
Error Triggers
\n
\n
\n
\n
Fallback on HTTP 5xx errors
\n
Retry via fallback when the origin server returns a 500-level status code.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Fallback on timeout
\n
Retry via fallback when the primary server exceeds the connection timeout.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Fallback on DNS failure
\n
Retry via fallback when the hostname cannot be resolved.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n \n
\n
\n
Advanced Rendering
\n
\n
\n
\n
Script tags loaded per page
\n
Maximum number of <script src> tags loaded when rendering a page. Higher values help complex React / Next.js / Vite apps but use more memory. Default: 250.
\n
\n
\n \n 250\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Images prefetched per page
\n
Maximum number of images fetched and inlined before the page is displayed. Lower values speed up initial load on image-heavy sites; higher values improve visual completeness. Default: 300.
\n
\n
\n \n 300\n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n \n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Media Range Requests
\n
\n
\n
\n
Enable Range request support
\n
Forward Range headers and handle 206 Partial Content responses. Fixes video/audio seeking and embedded media playback on most sites.
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
\n

\n
\n
\n
\n

\n
When Gust receives a file it can't display (e.g. .zip, .exe), automatically trigger a browser download instead of showing an error page.
